name: Baukol-Noonan Trout Pond and Campground
note: Gravel camping loop around a picnic shelter beside the boat ramp on Baukol-Noonan Dam, a reclaimed coal-mine reservoir inside Game and Fish's Harris M. Baukol Wildlife Management Area. No sites, fee or booking are published, so call Divide County before setting out. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: 2026-11-12, public-campground ladder step 1: Divide County's own page is titled 'Baukol-Noonan Trout Pond and Campground' (dividecountynd.org/residents/recreation_entertainment/noonan_trout_pond/, seen as a search-result title only: the site refused an earlier fetch and was not retried). Corroborated by ND Game and Fish data: GNF_FishingWaters 'Fishing Facilities' layer (ndgishub.nd.gov, read 2026-11-12) lists at Baukol-Noonan Dam (lake 475) a concrete boat ramp, dock and accessible concrete vault toilet owned by 'Divide County WRD', a security light ('WRD') and a fishing pier ('Baukol Noonan Sportsmens Club'); the Fishing Waters layer says public access is 'WMA - 1,381 acres which includes the entire lake and shoreline'; the WMA layer puts the pin inside Harris M. Baukol WMA (1,271 ac), and gf.nd.gov/wma (updated August 2026) names Harris M. Baukol among WMAs open to camping Thursday-Monday. Esri imagery shows a gravel loop (~70 m across) around a picnic shelter, with tables and small posts, next to the toilet and ramp lot, reached by section-line gravel roads. Directories: AllStays 'Baukol-Noonan Trout Pond' (48.871971,-102.95031: tents, electric, water, toilets) and The Dyrt 'Baukol Campground' (48.872,-102.950: public, electric hookups, toilets, no reviews). Not on the ND HHS licensed list (07.17.2025; Divide County rows: Crosby Meadows, Divide County Fairgrounds, Noonan Lions RV Park, Old School Center, Skjermo Lake). Not on RV Life (Algolia, 15 km radius); no Google Maps campground (Google has only 'Baukol-Noonan Dam Boating Access', 4.4 on 5 reviews with no text). Separate from 6004 Noonan Lions Campground: 4.4 km WSW, in town at Main St on its own HHS licence (Noonan Lions Club, 7 lots). No other DB entry within 5 km (next 6039 Columbus City Park, 13 km). Long-stay/workforce: a WMA campground under a 10-day camping limit and a Tuesday/Wednesday closure cannot house oil-field workers; no lots, seasonal or monthly rates anywhere. No horse, 4WD or rig-length wording found; open gravel loop. Public, no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-12: Esri World Imagery 600 m and 200 m frames centred near 48.8721,-102.9502 (both rendered). The camping loop sits on open grass on the reservoir's south shore, between the narrow west arm and the main east-west pool. From the loop's west road, open water lies ~65-70 m west across open mown grass and a reed/cattail fringe; to the north, the boat-ramp lot and its access road separate the loop from the main pool (~70-90 m). Nothing screens the view (no tree belt on those sides; the shelterbelt is east of the loop), but no pad lies within ~50 m of open water, and the lot and road are uses in the way -> lakeview, not lakefront. G&F 2021 contour map (gf.nd.gov/gnf/maps/fishing/lakecontours/baukolnoonan2021.pdf) shows the ramp, pier and vault toilet at this spot on the shore. Dam check: the spillway/water control (G&F layer, NID ND00416) is at 48.8742,-102.9483, ~300 m NE at the pool's outlet; the loop is on the reservoir side, at grade with the shore (Open-Meteo DEM 604 m vs G&F full pool 1,982.6 ft = 604.3 m NAVD88; no embankment visible between loop and water), so it is not below a berm.
facilities_source: ND Game and Fish GNF_FishingWaters MapServer layer 4 'Fishing Facilities' (ndgishub.nd.gov), Baukol-Noonan Dam: 'Vault Tiolet, Conct.', Useable Y, Active, Handicap Y, Ownership 'Divide County WRD', at 48.87224,-102.950072; read 2026-11-12. Also on the G&F 2021 contour map legend.

booking.note: No camping on Tuesday or Wednesday nights except holidays, and all equipment must be removed those days (ND Game and Fish rule for the Harris M. Baukol Wildlife Management Area).

booking_source: https://gf.nd.gov/wma (last updated August 2026: Harris M. Baukol, Divide County, listed among WMAs 'closed to camping on Tuesdays and Wednesdays except holidays'; 'Camping for longer than 10 consecutive days on any wildlife management area is prohibited') and https://gf.nd.gov/wma-listing (Harris M. Baukol, 1,271 acres: 'Overnight camping prohibited Tuesdays and Wednesdays, except holidays'), read 2026-11-12; the pin is inside that WMA per the G&F GNF_PLOTSGuide 'Wildlife Management Areas' layer
curation_note: ND lead 22 (2026-11-12): added on the county's page title plus G&F facility and WMA data; no firsthand camper report and no readable operator page. Directories (AllStays, The Dyrt) and the county page's search snippet claim sites 'with electricity or without', water and a picnic area at '600 Farm To Market Road'; imagery shows small posts along the loop that may be pedestals, but count and amperage are unknown, so hookups were left unknown. The directories' phone 701-925-3000 is the same number stored on 6004 and could not be tied to an owner, so it was not used. Ownership local: the ramp, dock and toilet belong to the Divide County Water Resource District on G&F's WMA (same handling as 5951 McGregor Dam). 'Trout Pond' is the county's name for Baukol-Noonan Dam (lake 475, stocked with rainbow trout per G&F 2018), not the separate 7.6-acre Baukol-Noonan East Mine Pond 500 m north-west. --Claude
flags: Thin evidence: kept on public-ladder step 1 by the county page TITLE only (dividecountynd.org refused and was not retried), corroborated by G&F facility data (Divide County WRD toilet, ramp, dock, security light), the WMA camping rule and imagery of a loop with a shelter. No camper report, no Google campground listing, not HHS-licensed. If AWH wants a readable agency statement or a dated report, it is a skip until the phone answers.
Tuesday/Wednesday camping ban applies (Harris M. Baukol WMA, gf.nd.gov/wma August 2026) plus the 10-day WMA limit; carried in booking as for Smishek Lake and McGregor Dam.
Hookups, fees, season and site count left absent (unknown). Directories say electric and water; nothing official read says so.
Waterfront lakeview: loop ~65-70 m from open water across open grass and reeds; no pads within ~50 m.
Pin moved from AllStays' 48.871971,-102.95031 (the ramp lot edge) to the loop centre 48.87205,-102.95010.
No phone stored: the directories' 701-925-3000 is the number already on 6004 Noonan Lions and has no confirmed owner.

Phone list: Divide County (courthouse, Crosby; or the Divide County Water Resource District / Park Board) about Baukol-Noonan Trout Pond and Campground: is overnight camping on the loop by the boat ramp still allowed, how many sites have electricity and what amperage, is there a fee and how is it paid, is there drinking water, and what is the season? Secondary: ND Game and Fish 701-328-6300 for the WMA camping rule.
